response.description: Gameplay attributes associated with a session

list.name: ServerControlsSetup
list.description: Does the server control the game's setup? If yes, the host's lobby settings will be disabled. Set automatically from the server's settings, can't be modified by HTTP or Lua APIs.

list.name: ServerControlsTrack
list.description: Does the server control the track selection? If yes, everyone's track selection will be disabled.

list.name: ServerControlsVehicleClass
list.description: Does the server control the vehicle class selection? If yes, everyone's vehicle selection will be restricted to vehicles from class VehicleClassId, any attempts to change to another class via the garage will not work. Should be always combined with the FORCE_SAME_VEHICLE_CLASS session flag.

list.name: ServerControlsVehicle
list.description: Does the server control the vehicle selection? If yes, everyone's vehicle selection will be restricted to vehicle VehicleModelId. Should be always combined with the FORCE_IDENTICAL_VEHICLE session flag.

list.name: GridSize
list.description: Total maximum grid size, including AI participants. Can be modified only for the 'next session' and can never be larger than the maximum session size set in the server config.

list.name: GridLayout
list.description: Defines how players are distributed over the grid. Can be modified only for the 'next session'. Use (position+10) to set exact position of admin player. Use enum value for other cases. The enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/grid_positions or in Lua global tables lists.enums.grid_positions, GridPositions and value_to_grid_positions.

list.name: MaxPlayers
list.description: Maximum number of players. Can't be higher than GridSize, but can be lower and then the extra slots will be reserved for AI vehicles. Can be modified only for the 'next session'.

list.name: OpponentDifficulty
list.description: Difficulty of AI participants. Valid values in range 0-100.

list.name: Flags
list.description: Session setup flags. The flag values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/flags/session or in Lua global tables lists.flags.session, SessionFlags and value_to_session_flag.

list.name: Privacy
list.description: Session privacy, defined when the session is created. Usually server-hosted sessions will be public and use password-protection or blacklists/whitelists to control who can join them. The possible values are 0 to 2, with 0 meaning public, 1 for friends only and 2 for private.

list.name: AutoAdvanceSession
list.description: When enabled, Sessions will advance from the end leaderboard automatically if there is no input from the host. (0) disabled (1) enabled

list.name: DamageType
list.description: Damage type. The enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/damage or in Lua global tables lists.enums.damage, Damage and value_to_damage.

list.name: DamageScale
list.description: Scales the forces required to damage/detach parts when vehicle damage is enabled. The enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/damage_scale or in Lua global tables lists.enums.damage_scale, DamageScale and value_to_damage_scale.

list.name: DamageRandomFailures
list.description: Enables/disables/timescales random mechanical failures. he enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/random_failures or in Lua global tables lists.enums.random_failures, Damage and value_to_random_failure

list.name: TireWearType
list.description: Tire wear type. The enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/tire_wear or in Lua global tables lists.enums.tire_wear, TireWear and value_to_tire_wear.

list.name: FuelUsageType
list.description: Fuel usage type. The enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/fuel_usage or in Lua global tables lists.enums.fuel_usage, FuelUsage and value_to_fuel_usage.

list.name: PenaltiesType
list.description: Penalties type. The enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/penalties or in Lua global tables lists.enums.penalties, Penalties and value_to_penalties.

list.name: PitWhiteLinePenalty
list.description: White line penalty on pit exit. Set 1 to enable.

list.name: DriveThroughPenalty
list.description: Drive through penalty. Set 1 to enable.

list.name: AllowedCutsBeforePenalty
list.description: The number of times a driver will be warned for cutting the track before a drive-through penalty (or time penalty if drive-throughs are disabled) is issued. 0 to disable cut penalties, valid range supported by game is 1 to 50.

list.name: PitSpeedLimit
list.description: The pit speed limit in KPH. Values between 40 and 200 in steps of 5 are valid (rounded down when needed). Unset, 0 or < 40 will result in track default limit.

list.name: ManualPitStops
list.description: TODO: rename to PitControl. Control mode while driving through pits. The enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/pit_control or in Lua global tables lists.enums.pit_control, PitControl and value_to_pit_control.

list.name: ManualRollingStarts
list.description: Does the admin set manual rolling starts.  Set 1 to enable.

list.name: AllowedViews
list.description: Allowed cameras. Only Any (0) and CockpitHelmet (2) are supported by the game, writes of other values will be ignored. The enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/allowed_view or in Lua global tables lists.enums.allowed_view, AllowedView and value_to_allowed_view.

list.name: FullCourseYellows
list.description: Full Course Yellows. (0) disabled (1) enabled

list.name: TrackId
list.description: Track id. Players will be able to change this unless ServerControlsTrack is set to non-zero. The list of all valid tracks is available also via HTTP API at /api/list/tracks or in Lua global tables lists.tracks, id_to_track and name_to_track.

list.name: VehicleClassId
list.description: Vehicle class id, used when forcing vehicle class (session flag FORCE_SAME_VEHICLE_CLASS is set). If controlled from the server also set attribute ServerControlsVehicleClass. Latest class list is available also via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: MultiClassSlots
list.description: Number of additional vehicle classes (up to 3), used when Multi-class is forced (session flag FORCE_MULTI_VEHICLE_CLASS is set). If controlled from the server also set attribute ServerControlsVehicleClass. Number between 1 and 3 to specify ids from predefined templates in MultiClassSlotN.

list.name: MultiClassSlot1
list.description: Additional vehicle class id, slot 1. Latest class list is available via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: MultiClassSlot2
list.description: Additional vehicle class id, slot 2. Latest class list is available via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: MultiClassSlot3
list.description: Additional vehicle class id, slot 3. Latest class list is available via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: MultiClassSlot4
list.description: Additional vehicle class id, slot 4. Latest class list is available via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: MultiClassSlot5
list.description: Additional vehicle class id, slot 5. Latest class list is available via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: MultiClassSlot6
list.description: Additional vehicle class id, slot 6. Latest class list is available via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: MultiClassSlot7
list.description: Additional vehicle class id, slot 7. Latest class list is available via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: MultiClassSlot8
list.description: Additional vehicle class id, slot 8. Latest class list is available via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: MultiClassSlot9
list.description: Additional vehicle class id, slot 9. Latest class list is available via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicle_classes and in Lua global tables lists.vehicle_classes, id_to_vehicle_class and name_to_vehicle_class.

list.name: VehicleModelId
list.description: Vehicle model id, used when forcing identical vehicles (session flag FORCE_IDENTICAL_VEHICLES is set). If controlled from the server also set attribute ServerControlsVehicle. Latest vehicle list is available also via HTTP API at /api/list/vehicles and in Lua global tables lists.vehicles, id_to_vehicle and name_to_vehicle.

list.name: GameMode
list.description: Game mode hash. Multiplayer sessions always use -1958878043 or 'MP_RaceWeekend'.

list.name: MinimumOnlineRank
list.description: Minimum online safety rank. The enum values are available also via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/online_rep or in Lua global tables lists.enums.online_rep, OnlineRep and value_to_online_rep.

list.name: MinimumOnlineStrength
list.description: Minimum online strength. Valid values are in range from 100 to 5000.

list.name: Latitude
list.description: Track's latitude, in degrees multiplied by 1000 (so 180000 corresponds to 180 degrees).

list.name: Longitude
list.description: Track's longitude, in degrees multiplied by 1000.

list.name: Altitude
list.description: Track's base altitude, in millimeters.

list.name: PracticeLength
list.description: Length of practice session in minutes.

list.name: PracticeDateHour
list.description: Starting practice session date - hour of day.

list.name: PracticeDateProgression
list.description: Practice session date/time progression multiplier. Only some values between 1 and 60 are valid, the game might change the requested value to closest valid one.

list.name: PracticeWeatherProgression
list.description: Practice session time-based forecast progression multiplier. Only some values between 1 and 60 are valid, the game might change the requested value to closest valid one.

list.name: PracticeWeatherSlots
list.description: Number of practice session weather slots in use. Set to 0 to use real weather, and to a number between 1 and 4 to interpolate between predefined templates in WeatherSlotN.

list.name: PracticeWeatherSlot1
list.description: Fixed practice session weather, slot 1. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: PracticeWeatherSlot2
list.description: Fixed practice session weather, slot 2. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: PracticeWeatherSlot3
list.description: Fixed practice session weather, slot 3. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: PracticeWeatherSlot4
list.description: Fixed practice session weather, slot 4. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: PracticeLiveTrackPreset
list.description: Starting Live Track preset for the qualifying session. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather

list.name: QualifyLength
list.description: Length of qualification session in minutes.

list.name: QualifyDateHour
list.description: Starting qualifying session date - hour of day.

list.name: QualifyDateProgression
list.description: Qualifying session date/time progression multiplier. Only some values between 1 and 60 are valid, the game might change the requested value to closest valid one.

list.name: QualifyWeatherProgression
list.description: Qualifying session time-based forecast progression multiplier. Only some values between 1 and 60 are valid, the game might change the requested value to closest valid one.

list.name: QualifyWeatherSlots
list.description: Number of qualifying session weather slots in use. Set to 0 to use real weather, and to a number between 1 and 4 to interpolate between predefined templates in WeatherSlotN.

list.name: QualifyWeatherSlot1
list.description: Fixed qualifying session weather, slot 1. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: QualifyWeatherSlot2
list.description: Fixed qualifying session weather, slot 2. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: QualifyWeatherSlot3
list.description: Fixed qualifying session weather, slot 3. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: QualifyWeatherSlot4
list.description: Fixed qualifying session weather, slot 4. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: QualifyLiveTrackPreset
list.description: Starting Live Track preset for the qualifying session.

list.name: QualifyPrivateSession
list.description: Should qualifying session be private. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/privatesession or in Lua global tables lists.enums.privatesession, Weather and value_to_privatesession.

list.name: QualifyStintLimit
list.description: Number of times drivers can leave the pits. (0) disabled, (1-15) number stints allowed

list.name: QualifyLapLimit
list.description: Max number of laps drivers may complete in the session inc. in/out laps. (0) disabled, (3-15) the allowed lap count. NOTE: When QualifyStintLimit > 0 this limit applies per stint

list.name: RaceLength
list.description: Race 1 length in lap count.

list.name: RaceExtraLap
list.description: When enabled an extra full lap will be added to the race distance of timed races. Set to 0/1 to disable/enable.

list.name: RaceDateYear
list.description: Starting race date - year.

list.name: RaceDateMonth
list.description: Starting race date - month.

list.name: RaceDateDay
list.description: Starting race date - day of month.

list.name: RaceDateHour
list.description: Starting race date - hour of day.

list.name: RaceDateProgression
list.description: Race date/time progression multiplier. Only some values between 1 and 60 are valid, the game might change the requested value to closest valid one.

list.name: RaceWeatherProgression
list.description: Race session time-based forecast progression multiplier. Only some values between 1 and 60 are valid, the game might change the requested value to closest valid one.

list.name: RaceWeatherSlots
list.description: Number of race weather slots in use. Set to 0 to use real weather, and to a number between 1 and 4 to interpolate between predefined templates in WeatherSlotN.

list.name: RaceWeatherSlot1
list.description: Fixed race weather, slot 1. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: RaceWeatherSlot2
list.description: Fixed race weather, slot 2. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: RaceWeatherSlot3
list.description: Fixed race weather, slot 3. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: RaceWeatherSlot4
list.description: Fixed race weather, slot 4. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/weather or in Lua global tables lists.enums.weather, Weather and value_to_weather.

list.name: RaceRollingStart
list.description: Race rolling start value. Set 1 to enable.

list.name: RaceMandatoryPitStops
list.description: Race mandatory pit stops. Set 1 to enable.

list.name: RaceMandatoryPitStopsMinTyres
list.description: Minimum tyres required for a valid mandatory stop. 0-4

list.name: RaceFormationLap
list.description: Race session formation lap. Set 1 to enable. Only valid if Race Rolling Start is enabled.

list.name: RaceLiveTrackPreset
list.description: Starting Live Track preset for the race session.

list.name: RaceScheduledFullCourseYellow
list.description: If the session should be garaunteed to have an FCY. The enum values are available via HTTP API at /api/list/enums/scheduledfcy or in Lua global tables lists.enums.scheduledfcy, ScheduledFCY and value_to_scheduledfcy

list.name: DisablePitstopRefuelling
list.description: Prevents refuelling during pitstops when set to 1.

list.name: SessionState
list.description: Multiplayer session state. Valid values are None, Lobby, Loading, Race, PostRace, Returning.

list.name: SessionStage
list.description: Multiplayer session flow/stage. Valid values are Practice1, Practice2, Qualifying, Warmup, FormationLap, Race1. Race2 might be used if two-race format is implemented in multiplayer.

list.name: SessionPhase
list.description: Race manager phase. This is relatively internal value used during race startup synchronization. Valid values are PreCountDownSync, PreRace, CountDownWait, CountDown, Green, Invalid.

list.name: SessionTimeElapsed
list.description: Time elapsed since the start of the session (this stage), in seconds. Note that this value might currently start counting during loading and otehr transitions, and then reset back to zero when the race really starts.

list.name: SessionTimeDuration
list.description: Time elapsed since the start of the session, in seconds.

list.name: NumParticipantsValid
list.description: Number of 'valid' race participants, or positions.

list.name: NumParticipantsDisqualified
list.description: Number of disqualified participants.

list.name: NumParticipantsRetired
list.description: Number of retired participants.

list.name: NumParticipantsDNF
list.description: Number of DNF participants.

list.name: NumParticipantsFinished
list.description: Number of finished participants.

list.name: CurrentYear
list.description: Current race date - year.

list.name: CurrentMonth
list.description: Current race date - month.

list.name: CurrentDay
list.description: Current race date - day of month.

list.name: CurrentHour
list.description: Current race date - hour of day.

list.name: CurrentMinute
list.description: Current race date - minutes.

list.name: RainDensity
list.description: Rain density, this implies how "visually" rainy the weather is. Values between 0 and 1000 are valid.

list.name: WetnessOnPath
list.description: Average wetness on path. Values between 0 and 1000 are valid.

list.name: WetnessOffPath
list.description: Average wetness off path. Values between 0 and 1000 are valid.

list.name: WetnessAverage
list.description: Overall average wetness on track. Values between 0 and 1000 are valid.

list.name: WetnessPredictedMax
list.description: Predicted maximum wetness on track, if available.

list.name: WetnessMaxLevel
list.description: Maximum water level, this implies how "physically" rainy the weather is. Values between 0 and 1000 are valid.

list.name: TemperatureAmbient
list.description: Ambient temperature, in deg Celsius multiplied by 1000 (so 37000 is 37 degrees Celsius).

list.name: TemperatureTrack
list.description: Track temperature, in deg Celsius multiplied by 1000.

list.name: AirPressure
list.description: Air pressure.
